posts.author: Sam Dykstra
posts.text: No. 19 Guardians prospect Welbyn Francisca is 3-for-4 tonight and has multiple hits in five of his first six games in the Arizona Fall League. He's 16-for-26 (.615) and has struck out only once so far for Surprise. On an absolute heater in the desert.
